teaser.en: Its Digo name comes from *ruhani*, a spirit, and healers use this clove-scented basil against illnesses blamed on it.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na *ruhani*, pepo, na waganga hutumia mrihani huu wenye harufu ya karafuu dhidi ya magonjwa yanayohusishwa na pepo huyo.

summary.en: *Chirahani* is African basil, an aromatic woody herb with clove-scented leaves found in bush, farm edges and homesteads. It is used for scent, flavouring and medicine, including treatment of ailments attributed to spirits.
summary.sw: *Chirahani* ni mrihani, mmea wenye harufu nzuri na shina gumu, wenye majani yanayonukia karafuu, unaopatikana vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kuzunguka makazi. Hutumika kwa harufu yake, kukoleza chakula na kama dawa, ikiwemo kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo.

about.en: *Chirahani* is a woody herb or small shrub with square stems typical of the mint family. The leaves are soft, toothed and strongly aromatic, smelling of cloves when crushed. Small pale flowers grow in upright spikes at the tips of the branches.
about.sw: *Chirahani* ni mmea wenye shina gumu au kichaka kidogo, chenye mashina ya pembe nne kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya minanaa. Majani yake ni laini, yenye meno pembezoni na harufu kali, yakinukia karafuu yakipondwa. Maua madogo ya rangi hafifu huota kwenye vishada vilivyosimama wima kwenye ncha za matawi.

where.en: It grows in the bush and on farm edges, and is often kept around homesteads where its leaves are close at hand.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa mashamba, na mara nyingi hupandwa kuzunguka makazi ili majani yake yawe karibu.

uses.en: The leaves are used for their scent and as a flavouring. In medicine, the Digo of Diani boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria, and healers use it to treat ailments attributed to the spirit *ruhani*.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutumika kwa harufu yake na kukoleza chakula. Katika tiba, Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kutibu malaria, na waganga huutumia kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo *ruhani*.

culture.en: The name *chirahani* comes from *ruhani*, a spirit, and reflects the plant's place in healing illnesses blamed on spirits. Its other Digo name, *vumbamanga*, links its spiritual uses to Vumba in Tanzania.
culture.sw: Jina *chirahani* linatokana na *ruhani*, pepo, na linaonyesha nafasi ya mmea huu katika kuponya magonjwa yanayohusishwa na pepo. Jina lake jingine la Kidigo, *vumbamanga*, linahusisha matumizi yake ya kiroho na Vumba nchini Tanzania.

names.en: Digo has two names: *chirahani* and *vumbamanga*. Swahili calls it *mrihani* or *kivumbani*. In English it is African basil or clove basil.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili: *chirahani* na *vumbamanga*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mrihani* au *kivumbani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *African basil* au *clove basil*.

reason.en: Same genus; tree basil, also used in spiritual healing
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; kivumbani, pia hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho

reason.en: Another aromatic member of the mint family
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye harufu nzuri wa familia ya minanaa

reason.en: Another aromatic homestead herb used in medicine
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa nyumbani wenye harufu nzuri unaotumika kama dawa

reason.en: Another plant boiled for malaria in Diani
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaochemshwa kutibu malaria huko Diani
